data.body: **[P1] Preserve fatal failures across the invocation future.** Factories and start hooks run inside `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync`, so these rethrows are captured; `DurableExecutor` then converts them into `DurableExecutionOutput.failure`. A `ThreadDeath` is therefore suppressed and its worker continues, while VM failures look like normal durable failures. After unwrapping the handler failure, finalize published plugins and rethrow fatal causes instead of building a failure output. Add an end-to-end `DurableExecutor` test, since direct runner tests miss this boundary.
